2607.06233.title: Demonstrating TOFFEE: A Learned System for Synthesizing Data Agent Trajectories at Scale
2607.06233.paper_summary: LLM-powered data agents are playing an increasingly important role in data-driven decision making. However, existing data agents struggle to generalize to unseen data environments and analytical workflows, especially in heterogeneous enterprise settings. This creates a growing need for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories that capture complex analytical workflows for given data environments. Such trajectories support two key downstream uses: they can serve as supervised finetuning (SFT) data that adapts data agent models to the target domain, and as in-context learning (ICL) demonstrations to guide general-purpose LLMs in unfamiliar data environments. Thus, we introduce TOFFEE, a system for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories from given data environments via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with adaptive model selection and cross-task prefix reuse. We show that TOFFEE can effectively generate scalable trajectory data for complex analytical tasks across heterogeneous environments. In this demonstration, we present the system framework of TOFFEE, including its task pool construction, trajectory explorer, and learned cost model. We also introduce the web interface of TOFFEE and its workflow, and demonstrate two end-to-end scenarios: trajectory synthesis for data agent finetuning, and demonstration-augmented data agent reasoning.
2607.06233.paper_summary_zh: LLM 驅動的數據代理在數據驅動的決策中扮演著越來越重要的角色。<lb/>然而，現有的數據代理在面對未見數據環境和分析工作流程時，特別是在異質企業環境中，卻難以進行泛化。<lb/>這使得合成高質量的數據代理軌跡以捕捉特定數據環境下的複雜分析工作流程的需求日益增長。<lb/>這些軌跡支持兩個關鍵的下游用途：它們可以作為監督性微調（SFT）數據，將數據代理模型適應於目標領域，並且作為上下文學習（ICL）示範，以指導通用 LLM 在不熟悉的數據環境中。<lb/>因此，我們介紹 TOFFEE，一個通過蒙特卡羅樹搜索（MCTS）合成高質量數據代理軌跡的系統，並具備自適應模型選擇和跨任務前綴重用的功能。<lb/>我們展示了 TOFFEE 能夠有效生成可擴展的軌跡數據，以應對異質環境中的複雜分析任務。<lb/>在這次演示中，我們介紹了 TOFFEE 的系統框架，包括其任務池構建、軌跡探索器和學習成本模型。<lb/>我們還介紹了 TOFFEE 的網頁介面及其工作流程，並演示了兩個端到端場景：數據代理微調的軌跡合成，以及增強數據代理推理的示範。
